name: Thomson Reserve
address: 1 to 11 Bright Hill Drive, six blocks
developer: UOL Group, Singapore Land and CapitaLand Development (Tamarind Development Pte Ltd)
thesis: Upper Thomson MRT at the doorstep. Ai Tong within 1 km. 1,268 homes by UOL, Singapore Land and CapitaLand. Preview 17 October 2026.
price_basis: Unit sizes are the developer's, released 22 September 2026. Prices are still estimates: each column is the size multiplied by a possible launch psf, from $2,600 to $3,000. The $2,750 to $2,850 columns are where this launch is expected to open. The two Premium + Study rows are the two layouts of that type.

Low-density landscape: Minimal building footprint, six blocks on 555,067 sqft
Resort-scale facilities: 50m lap pool, island pool, infinity, wellness and leisure pools
Grand Clubhouse zone with the Classic Collection
Wellness and lifestyle: Main gym and a private gym
Pilates studio, hydro spa, wellness pods, yoga deck
Entertainment: KTV and entertainment room, recreation room
Golf simulator, kids' function room and playroom
Two collections: Luxury Collection, two 30-storey towers furthest from Bright Hill Drive
Classic Collection, four 21-storey towers within the Grand Clubhouse zone
PES units with direct facility access

evidence: deck-50
Private prices kept climbing. Thomson Reserve is in this market.
deck-51
The private market tells a different story.
deck-52
Land prices since 2023. Thomson Reserve's site went for $1,178 psf ppr in October 2024, near the bottom of this list.
deck-53
Land bids bounced 25% from the 2024 low, $1,143 to $1,428 in the first half of 2026. The next launch on this line will be built on dearer land than Thomson Reserve.
deck-54
Why swap from a non-harmonised home to a harmonised one: new launch prices barely moved for two years while resale caught up. Sell high, buy low.
deck-55
Sell high to buy low. Resale prices are now higher than brand new.
deck-56
Penrith, 936 sqft, $2.53M brand new. Stirling Residences, 1,055 sqft, $2.80M resale. The new one costs less. The same pair exists here: JadeScape resale against a new Thomson Reserve unit.
deck-57
The same idea again. Resale quantums are above brand new.
deck-58
Seaside Residences, 1,130 sqft resale, $2.8M. Emerald of Katong, 1,023 sqft brand new, $2.73M. Sell high, buy low.
deck-59
The results of harmonisation are already showing in the numbers.
deck-60
Emerald of Katong bought $222k cheaper than a similar Tembusu Grand unit. If it later sells at the same price, that is a $700k gain. Thomson Reserve is the harmonised launch on this line.
timeline: Balloting and booking, Option to Purchase
Progressive payments while the estate is built
Four years from purchase, Seller's Stamp Duty clears
Exit window: sell the flat, move in, or hold
falsify: The developer opens well above $2,800 psf on common sizes.
HDB resale prices pick up speed again through the second half of 2026, and the upgrader's window moves.
sources: URA caveats via the JND vault, latest August 2026. HDB resale via data.gov.sg, twelve months to September 2026. Land bids compiled from URA and HDB tender awards. Project facts and estimated prices from the ERA Project Marketing preliminary info kit and the 25 August developer brief. Justin Ngai's Thomson Reserve client deck, August 2026.

theme.concept: En plein air. Porcelain light, morning mist, teal blue and canopy green from the Thomson Reserve brand guide.
